column1: # Front-door pm-compat conformance matrix — the canonical cell list.
# One row = one assertion the harness runs. See README.md for the full design.
#   fixture     fixtures/<name>: nub envbridge npm yarn bun (nub projects),
#                 pnpm envbridge-pnpm (pnpm projects), or "-" for an
#   surface     config-read | config-write | env-bridge | env-gate | run-flag | lockfile
#   mode        doc  = hermetic, offline, every-PR leg
#               ref  = needs the network; runs only under REF=1
#   assert      assertion verb + args (see README "Assertion verbs")
# Every pnpm-project expectation below was derived by running pnpm 12.4.1 on the
# same fixture; a pnpm project that disagrees with it is a nub bug.
# ── config READ — the project .npmrc is read under both identities ────────────
# ── config READ — pnpm's own files are pnpm's, other tools' files nobody's ────
# pnpm 12.4.1 takes `registry` from pnpm-workspace.yaml over the project .npmrc,
# and reads its global config.yaml. A nub project reads neither (a
# pnpm-workspace.yaml cannot appear in one: it makes the project pnpm's), and
# reads no .yarnrc.yml or bunfig.toml — the .npmrc control must win there.
# ── config WRITE home — set a non-shared scalar, assert where it lands ─────────
# pnpm 12.4.1 writes a bare `config set` to its global config.yaml and
# `--location project` to pnpm-workspace.yaml (as `storeDir`). A nub project
# ── env: the npm_config_* bridge — nub's, and not pnpm 12's ──────────────────
# A nub project reads npm_config_* at install time and in `config get`. pnpm
# 12.4.1 reads neither: its install fetches from the default registry and its
# `config get registry` does not move. Each pair differs only in the identity.
# pnpm_config_* is pnpm's and nothing else's (pnpm 12.4.1 honors it). BUN_CONFIG_*
# is read by neither identity; its twin is nub-env-bridge-in-config-get, which
# keeps the `config get registry` env read path live in the same kind of project.
# Unread and untouched under both identities; a nub project writes nub.lock and
# points at `nub pm migrate`, a pnpm project writes pnpm-lock.yaml and says nothing.
# ── DEFERRED (add a row when the gap surfaces) ─────────────────────────────────
# config-read: nub.jsonc and the neutral package.json fields in a nub project.
# env-gate: the rest of the pnpm_config_* schema beyond store-dir.
# identity: a pin naming another pnpm version provisions that pnpm and delegates
# lockfile round-trip: covered by tests/conformance/run.sh + lockfile-conformance.
